language.footnote: Sets menus and narration on this device. Downloads keep the language they were made in.
language.switchFailedMessage: Your language is unchanged. Check your connection and try again.

auth.intro: Cloud Quran works without an account. Signing in syncs your reading position, bookmarks and preferences.
auth.syncDetailsLink: What syncs and who sees it
auth.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. Nothing has changed.
auth.failed: Sign-in didn't work. Please try again.
auth.sendFailed: We couldn't send a code to that address. Check it and try again.
auth.codeFailed: That code isn't right, or it has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.unavailable: This method isn't available in this build. Use your email address instead.

account.syncFootnote: Optional. Signing in carries your reading position, bookmarks and preferences to your other devices.
account.emailPending: No address shared yet — sign in again on this device to share one.
account.emailFootnote: The address for this account. An Apple private relay address works the same way.

data.syncToggleDescription: Carries your reading position, bookmarks and preferences to your other devices.
data.syncFootnote: Off stops this device sending and fetching. Nothing is deleted. It applies before you sign in too.
data.syncProcessors: Cloudflare stores it — never sold, never for ads. Your sign-in provider knows you signed in, not what you read.
data.syncToggleFailed: We couldn't save that setting on this device. Please try again.
data.footnote: These act on synced data only. Downloads and this device's settings are untouched.
data.exportDescription: A JSON file with everything synced to your account.
data.exportFailed: We couldn't put your export together. Check your connection and try again.
data.exportUnavailable: This device has nowhere to save the file. Try the export from the phone app.
data.purgeDescription: Empties everything synced to your account. Your account stays.
data.purgeDone: Your synced data is gone. Your account is untouched.
data.purgeFailed: Nothing was deleted. Check your connection and try again.

purgeDialog.title: Delete my synced data
purgeDialog.message: Deletes your synced data from every device. Your account stays. This can't be undone.

data.deleteAccountDescription: Deletes the account, its data and your sign-in methods. You keep reading as a guest.
data.deleteAccountDone: Your account and its data are gone. You're browsing as a guest again.
data.deleteAccountFailed: Your account was not deleted, and nothing was changed. Please try again.
data.deleteAccountOffline: You need a connection to delete your account. Nothing was changed.

deleteAccountDialog.title: Delete my account
deleteAccountDialog.message: Deletes your account, its synced data and your sign-in methods. This can't be undone.
